name: Gem of Seeing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Truesight
powers.text: 1 charge: Truesight to 120 ft for 10 minutes while you peer through the gem.

summary: 3 charges: Truesight out to 120 ft for 10 minutes.
text: Use a Magic action to spend 1 of the gem's 3 charges; for the next 10 minutes, looking through the gem grants you Truesight out to 120 feet. Each dawn it recovers 1d3 spent charges.
